systems.system: Bridge Liberia live data collection and monitoring
systems.country_label: live data collection and monitoring (LEAP, Bridge Liberia)
systems.owner: Bridge Liberia, a LEAP partner operating public schools for the Ministry of Education on philanthropic funding
systems.tiers: LEAP-supported public schools (the programme as a whole supports 475, about 18 per cent of 2,703 public primary schools); principals, district and county education officers and Ministry officials see trends at their own level

note: No fact: the report says a LEAP partner's schools collect data during the year on principal and teacher attendance, lesson delivery, student attendance and observation ratings, which Ministry officials can see as trends, but not that a record is kept per learner nor how many schools do it; left unclassified for the parent to rule on.
